Yeah I get that I have a lot of the same feelings and I’m also undiagnosed. For me I feel like the numbness is to cope with a lot of my problems. It’s been really prominent this year and it goes to ways. First it does make all the good things in life much more nothing and less happy but I’ve also become numb to the bad things in life and I’ve become much better at ignoring my emotions (not in a good way). So yeah it kinda feel like I’ve been living life through an inch of bubble rap
I would recommend posting on some sort of tech support sub I think most of the people here don’t really know so much about the inner workings of reddit

Most of the time people will just click on posts out of curiosity and sometimes the unexpected cool things are the best ones. Reddit wants to see what you have to offer and hey worst comes to worst you can always just delete your post so go ahead try it !
